title: helianthus riparius
intro: Helianthus riparius, commonly known as Swamp Sunflower, is a perennial plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving symptoms of gastrointestinal issues due to its anti-inflammatory and carminative properties. The therapeutic actions of Helianthus riparius are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a potential candidate for the management of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
